تنتظموا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَظِمُوا (tantaẓimū) /tan.ta.ðˤi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَظَمَ (intaẓama)
# تُنْتَظَمُوا (tuntaẓamū) /tun.ta.ðˤa.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَظَمَ (intaẓama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
